claims.evidence: No photo shows a receipt, tag, or purchase date; fan shown already in use on tiled floor.
No video or clip shows the fan powered on, oscillating, or changing speeds.

risks.risk: Motor may not power on or run smoothly
risks.proof: Short video of the fan plugged in, spinning, and oscillating at each speed setting

risks.risk: Unusual noise or vibration from worn bearings
Actual age/usage higher than claimed 'brand new'
risks.proof: Close-up of manufacture date sticker or original purchase receipt

risks.risk: Missing or unknown wattage, speed options, or remote
risks.proof: Photo of control switch/remote and rating label
risks.if_unproven: priced as base model, no remote

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or damage on blades/cage not visible in given angles
risks.proof: Full 360° photos including underside of base and blade edges

risks.risk: No original box or accessories despite 'brand new' claim
risks.proof: Photo of box, manual, or warranty card
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit, no accessories

proof_requests: Video of fan powered on, oscillating, and cycling through speed settings
Close-up of rating label showing wattage and model number
Photo of any remote control or accessories
Photo of original box/receipt if available
Close-up of blade edges and cage for cracks or rust
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a standard pedestal fan, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified-condition used unit pending operational proof.
